_meta.status: DRAFT for CRM QA and Director review. Not approved for sending. Per the implementation plan, nothing is sent or published without owner approval at each step.
_meta.source_conventions: Voice and structure follow content/emails-and-messages.en.json (generic templates). CRM placeholders are lower_snake_case because they map 1:1 to renderCustomer vars; see placeholders[].generic_equivalent.

{{recipient_first_name}}.meaning: First name of the person receiving the message (parent, or the adult learner).

{{ceremony}}.meaning: Ceremony name in the recipient's language.

{{rabbi_name}}.meaning: Rabbi's display name with title, from the rabbi data. FR: no article, so it works at the start of a sentence.

{{login_email}}.meaning: Email address used to log in.

{{password_reset_url}}.meaning: One-time password reset link (email only). Never a password.

{{link_expiry}}.meaning: Pre-formatted validity of a setup/reset link, with unit, singular/plural handled by the CRM.

{{portal_url}}.meaning: Student/parent portal URL (deep link to the relevant screen when possible).

{{ai_assistant_url}}.meaning: Link to the family's AI assistant (StudentAssistant).

{{lesson_date_family}}.meaning: Lesson date in the FAMILY's time zone, localized.

{{lesson_time_family}}.meaning: Lesson time in the FAMILY's time zone, localized.

{{lesson_time_jerusalem}}.meaning: Lesson time in Jerusalem (Asia/Jerusalem), localized. If the Jerusalem date differs from the family's date, append the weekday in parentheses.

{{family_timezone_label}}.meaning: Human-readable name of the family's time zone, from students.timezone.

{{abroad}}.meaning: SECTION FLAG, not text. true when students.timezone is not Asia/Jerusalem. {{#abroad}}…{{/abroad}} renders the Jerusalem-time line only for families outside Israel (plan §3).

{{zoom_link}}.meaning: Zoom join URL for the lesson(s).

{{lesson_summary}}.meaning: Rabbi's lesson summary, already in the family's language (never auto-translated). Plain text, may be multi-line.

{{homework}}.meaning: Practice before next lesson, rabbi-written, in the family's language. Also a SECTION: empty = block dropped.

{{payment_url}}.meaning: Secure payment link for the complete course.

{{price}}.meaning: Course price formatted for the family's currency and locale.

{{message_excerpt}}.meaning: Optional first ~200 chars of the portal message, plain text, only if written in the family's language. Also a SECTION: empty = block dropped. Email only.

{{deletion_date}}.meaning: Date when the recordings will be removed, localized, family time zone.

{{recordings_list}}.meaning: Optional list of the lesson dates whose recordings will be removed, one per line. Also a SECTION.

{{recordings_url}}.meaning: Link to the recordings screen in the portal.

_meta.sections: {{#abroad}}, {{#homework}}, {{#message_excerpt}}, {{#recordings_list}} open an optional block closed by {{/name}}. Email bodies only; never in SMS or WhatsApp.
formatting_rules: US-neutral English, second person, short paragraphs. Greeting 'Hi {{recipient_first_name}},' and signature 'Warmly, / The Zoom Mitzvah International team' (added to every email body).
Times: 'h:mm a.m./p.m.' always with minutes, e.g. '5:30 p.m.', '5:00 p.m.', '12:30 a.m.'.
Dates: 'Wednesday, March 12' (weekday, month day; no year unless the date is in another year).
Time zone label: '<City> time', e.g. 'New York time', 'London time', 'Jerusalem time'.
Spelling: 'email' (no hyphen) in EN; glossary terms only (Bar Mitzvah, lesson never class, rabbi never tutor). No em dashes.

channel_rules.rendering: renderCustomer(type, lang, vars) reads templates[type] from customer-templates.<lang>.json. {{name}} = value; {{#name}}…{{/name}} = section rendered only when vars[name] is truthy / non-empty (Mustache semantics). Any placeholder left unresolved = do not send, log an error. HTML-escape all values in email. Hebrew (lang 'he') never uses these files: the existing Hebrew code runs unchanged.
channel_rules.email: body is plain text with \n; the brand wrapper (email-brand.ts, dir='ltr') turns blank lines into paragraphs and renders cta_label + the URL from cta_url_placeholder as a button. The signature is already part of body.
channel_rules.sms: sms.text must stay within 1 GSM-7 segment (160 chars) after rendering. URLs in SMS must be shortened by the CRM (target ≤ 30 chars); chars_sample is computed with 30-char links and the sample values in this file. Names with non-GSM letters (e.g. 'Noémie' is fine, 'Zoë' is not) switch the SMS to UCS-2 (70 chars per segment): the sender should fall back to email/WhatsApp in that case. If a rendered SMS still exceeds 160 chars (very long names), send it as a 2-part concatenated SMS rather than cutting text; never truncate a link. SMS4Free delivery abroad is not yet confirmed.
channel_rules.whatsapp: Each text must be submitted to Meta as a WhatsApp Business template (category UTILITY) before use, sent only to opted-in families. Named placeholders map to Meta positional {{1}}, {{2}}… in order of first appearance. Meta rules respected here: no text starts or ends with a placeholder; parameters must not contain line breaks (so no homework/summary/excerpt in WhatsApp); *bold* formatting only.
channel_rules.security: No password ever appears in any channel. Password-setup / reset links appear in email only; SMS and WhatsApp for import-external-customer.welcome, recover-password and reset-user-password only point to the email.

generic_template_mapping.note: The import welcome merges payment welcome + portal access. No payment wording (the import may not follow a payment).
Password links are email-only in the CRM keys; SMS/WhatsApp point to the email.
No CRM function sends a standalone 'rabbi matched' message; the rabbi is introduced in these three.
calendar_url and reschedule_url dropped: not confirmed to exist in the CRM.
Next-lesson line removed (not confirmed that the function has it); homework is an optional section.
No customer function in plan §5. Related: check-recording-deletion.
No customer function in plan §5 (receipts likely from the payment provider).
Testimonial-consent optional_line not carried over (no confirmed consent step).

functions_not_covered.sync-external-customers: Reuse import-external-customer.welcome if it sends a welcome; confirm what (if anything) it sends to customers.
functions_not_covered.parent-feedback: Appears to be the endpoint behind the ParentFeedback form; confirm whether it sends a customer message (e.g. a thank-you). No template written.
functions_not_covered.admin-preview-parent-emails: Admin preview tool: should render send-parent-feedback-emails in the family's language. No separate template.
functions_not_covered.16 Meta WhatsApp templates + DB triggers: Need the current list of Hebrew template names to map each to a key here; new EN/FR WhatsApp templates need Meta approval.

open_questions: Does reset-user-password currently send a temporary password? If so, the EN/FR flow must switch to a reset link.
Are trial lessons free or paid? Copy says nothing about the trial's price until confirmed.
Do trial families get portal access (check-trial-completion CTA)?
Can families download recordings, and what is the retention period? Copy mentions neither.
Do rabbis teaching EN/FR families write summaries and messages in that language? If not, summaries cannot be sent (no auto-translation).
Does SMS4Free deliver abroad? Is there a URL shortener for SMS?
EUR/USD charging via Grow or Stripe (trial-upgrade-payment must wait).

email.preheader: Your parent portal is ready. Set your password to get started.
email.body:
Hi {{recipient_first_name}},

Welcome to Zoom Mitzvah International. We're delighted to be part of {{student_first_name}}'s {{ceremony}} journey.

Your parent portal is ready. It's where you'll find the lesson schedule (always in your local time), lesson recordings, messages from your rabbi and your personal AI assistant.

Your login email: {{login_email}}

To get started, set your password with the button below. For your security, this link is valid for {{link_expiry}}.

Next step: we'll be in touch about {{student_first_name}}'s rabbi and the first lesson.

A question in the meantime? Your AI assistant answers day or night, in English: {{ai_assistant_url}}

Warmly,
The Zoom Mitzvah International team
